points.description: States that all the dimensions except the first must be specified when passing a multi-dimensional array to a function (equivalent wording such as 'every dimension apart from the first' earns the mark; the first dimension may be left out).

deductions.description: Says that all dimensions, including the first, must be specified, or that only the first dimension is needed.

rubric.notes: The model answer is a single idea: every dimension except the first must be given. Full marks go to a student who states this rule in any equivalent wording. A student who says all dimensions must be given, or that only the first is needed, gets no marks."
